title: Python: Q1, completed annotation reading: quoted forward references and names imported under TYPE_CHECKING are annotations (DEC-303 (a22) item 4 Q1, (a2) item 3)
description: DEC-303 (a22) item 4, Q1: quoted forward references and names imported under TYPE_CHECKING are annotations under (a2) item 3 and are IN; completing annotation reading carries out an existing rule and is not a new one. Q2 (self.attr.m()) and Q3 (return types) are OUT as (a2) item 3 rules; any change to them is a new ruling, considered only after the item 5 measurement. This is the 'completed annotation reading' of (a23)'s build order and is on the hold list. Record only on filing: NOTHING is built before opum-doc reads the (a22) item 5 development measurement table. No glyph-cli task for Q1 existed before this one (GCLI-75 and GCLI-110 mention TYPE_CHECKING only as conditional imports).

acceptanceCriteria.text: BEFORE ANY BUILD: the (a22) item 5 development measurement table is delivered to opum-doc: on one or two development repositories, at least one low-annotation, the in-package sites enumerated by name and alias census independent of glyph and labelled by hand, and the share of those sites resolvable (i) by the current rules, (ii) adding the item-3 groups, (iii) adding completed annotation reading (Q1), (iv) adding single-assignment self.attr (Q2), (v) adding followed return annotations (Q3), (vi) needing flow or value inference; nothing is built before opum-doc reads the table
opum-doc reads the table and rules whether and in what order Q1 is built; this criterion stays unchecked until that ruling is recorded

if built: a quoted forward reference and a name imported under TYPE_CHECKING, used as an annotation of one known class, each resolve a method call on the annotated name as the unquoted, runtime-imported annotation does, each fixture red before and green after with the callee symbol pinned and the full bin delta, with a refused fixture per shape that is not an annotation of one known class and positive twins

if built: Optional and Union-with-None unwrapping, Q2 and Q3 shapes stay unchanged (refused fixtures asserting no edge and the bin unchanged), mutants by name observed red, and the five-pin corpus diff script-asserted with every in-repo edge created or removed reported to opum-doc before the clear

implementationNotes: Q1 gate: DEC-303 (a23), 2026-11-25 14:30Z, satisfies GCLI-121's Q1 gate (opum-doc ranking relayed 2026-11-26). Build nothing before the ranking reaches this task.
